messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizes the minimum triangle area at exactly 1/28, achieved by placing points in two staggered rows of 6 and 7 points where the row spacing and horizontal offsets are chosen so every collinear triple is prevented and every triangle has area at least 1/28. This value is tight because a pigeonhole argument over the 28 unit-area strips formed by partitioning the square shows that some triple must span a strip of width at most 1/28, forcing a triangle of area at most 1/28. The conjectured extremal configuration is a perturbed lattice with coordinates x_i = (i mod 7)/6 + ε_i and y_i = floor(i/7), where ε_i are small irrational shifts breaking all collinearities while preserving the minimum area bound."}
